###  Hello, I'm Addisu

I am a Biomedical Engineer and Data Scientist with a deep fascination for the intersection of engineering, machine learning, and human health. I hold a **Master's in Data Science** from the Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology (Skoltech) and a **Bachelor's in Electronics & Communication Engineering with a specialization in Biomedical Engineering** from Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT).

My work focuses on developing AI-driven solutions for biomedical challenges—from medical image analysis and disease classification to predictive modeling and biomarker discovery. I believe in the transformative potential of AI in healthcare and am committed to building robust, interpretable, and clinically relevant computational tools.

I am actively seeking PhD and R&D opportunities in **Computational Pathology, Medical AI, and Biomedical Imaging**.
